name: commit0

design.kept_Y_rule: correct-Y adherence >= 0.7 over N = 20 forced samples (4 per family, all 5 families)
design.padding_twin_rule: pooled default share >= 0.9 per Y (N = 20); a (k, Y) cell with < 3 of 4 default is excluded
design.ban_landing_rule: algorithms with share >= 0.2 of the W1-W3 ban samples (N = 30), correct programs
design.target_rule: 5 correct programs per algorithm (ban samples first for the ban's landing algorithm, then TRAIN-family forced samples), first 48 response tokens, exact generated ids, programs with < 48 tokens excluded (T03 fallback: >= 16 tokens, flagged), clean openings preferred; default set from the W1-W3 noun-0 twins; disjoint validation sets of 3
design.objective: C = LME_{Pi_Y} ll - LME_{Pi_D} ll over the first 48 response tokens; loss = -C_k
design.map_class: Linear(4096 -> 16) under parametrizations.orthogonal, nested ranks (1, 2, 4, 8, 16), fp32
design.fit_budget: Adam lr 2e-3, 4 micro-batches of 1 pair per step (stratified by source context), 150 steps, rank cycled [16,8,4,2,1] by micro-batch, validation every 25 steps (TRAIN sources -> VAL bases, all ranks), best state kept, early stop after 3 non-improving validations; equal budget for every control fit; +75 steps for every fit of a task if the main fit is still improving at 150
design.layer_profile_rule: teacher-forced full-state exchange at single blocks (10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26) + bands 12-23, 0-35 + read position on 24 aligned TRAIN pairs; L* = argmax mean gain, ties within 0.25 nats to the smaller block
design.band_fallback_rule: if TRANSFER(full@L*) < 0.5 x TRANSFER(band 12-23) on the W5 ban source in generation, the map is ONE R shared over blocks 12-23 and every later step uses that site
design.k_star_rule: smallest k with generation RECOVERY_k >= 0.8 on the ban source, else 16
design.P1: PASS on a task if some k <= 16 has RECOVERY_k >= 0.8 AND RECOVERY_k - RECOVERY_random_k >= 0.4 AND exact McNemar DAS vs random (correct-Y, paired by slot, pooled over held-out sources at that k) p < 0.01 after Holm across tasks AND permuted-label TRANSFER <= 0.1 AND pass >= 0.8 x BASE pass; on T2 also random-init held-out TF gain < 0.5 x trained gain. Overall PASS on >= 2 tasks. DISCONFIRMED if RECOVERY_16 < 0.5 on every task.
design.C: routing(Y) = #correct Y / #correct off-default; CATEGORICAL if routing >= 0.6 for >= 2 non-default Y on >= 2 tasks at the P1 k; MARGIN-AND-LADDER if routing <= 0.2 for every Y other than the runner-up while off-default TRANSFER >= 0.5; else MIXED; a Y whose full-state exchange does not route (< 0.6) is 'not routable at this site'
design.dormant_flag: projected-map TF retention < 0.5 OR reverse recovery < 0.5 while forward recovery >= 0.8
design.M: z = mean over spec positions of R_16 h at the site; paraphrase null = distances of 60 twins + padtwins + P0 to the default-condition centroid; seeds/instructions scored by percentile
design.R: lambda in {0,0.2,0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8,1.0,1.25,1.5}, N = 20 each; logistic width = 2 s ln 9; DISCRETE if width <= 0.3 and hybrids <= 5% of correct programs
design.novelty_rule: every correct 'other' program -> two blind judges of different families + nearest known solutions; 'no correct novel algorithm' claimed only at a count of 0

generation.sampler: exp30 float64 inverse-CDF CRN, T = 1, top-p 1, no top-k, fence stop

cells: BASE W5 twin (nouns cycle slot mod 12)
BASE pooled padtwin (family 3 + s mod 2, kept Y (s div 2) mod |Y|)
FULL-STATE ban + each kept forced Y
RANDOM k16 x3 ban; k16 x1 forced; k* x1 ban
PERMUTED k16 + k* ban; k16 one forced Y
RPOS DAS k16 + full-state at R

predictions.L_star: a single block in 14-20, or the band fallback on T10
predictions.C: CATEGORICAL on T10 (forced BFS -> BFS, forced DFS -> DFS); MARGIN-AND-LADDER or not-routable for Floyd-Warshall / Dial on T2
predictions.M: random seeds inside the paraphrase null; the semantic seed outside it

note: analysis code (src/analysis7.py) is frozen in an amendment commit before any held-out generation is scored (deviation: not in commit #0)
